pr_title: Add test coverage for generic types
pr_body:
Added a test case to cover the common scenario of generic types used to represent paginated data.

Also closes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/55883.

issue_context.title: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi generate scheme doc Error when minimalapi endpoint return `ValidationProblem`
comments:
Thanks for reporting this issue, @vipwan!

It occurs because the `OpenApiJsonSchemaConverter` wasn't correctly handling the `additionalProperties` key that was generated by System.Text.Json. I've opened a PR to fix this in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/55940.

review_comments: Do we need to add a default case with `reader.Skip();` to avoid future breaks?
